subject.title: feat(ui): editable file panel with CodeMirror and sessions.files.set hash-CAS writes

question: Should this bounded hash-CAS `sessions.files.set` contract become OpenClaw's canonical workspace editor, rather than or combined with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95956?
rationale: The choice defines a new public remote mutation boundary, including accepted external-writer race semantics, while two viable open branches currently implement overlapping contracts.

options.title: Adopt and repair this PR
options.body: Keep the existing-file hash-CAS design, fix capability and Markdown behavior, and require real-Gateway proof.

options.title: Adopt the older PR
options.body: Choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95956 if its broader preview and editing contract is preferred.

options.title: Consolidate into one replacement
options.body: Select the permanent protocol first and combine only the strongest proven pieces from both branches.

recommendation.title: Adopt and repair this PR
recommendation.body: Keep the existing-file hash-CAS design, fix capability and Markdown behavior, and require real-Gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current file-viewer surface and authored the canonical feature issue and this exact contract proposal.
